note: Each example id maps to assets/examples/<id>.png. 'refs' are earlier outputs passed as reference images.

examples.title: Free-form prompt
examples.prompt: a cozy coffee shop in the morning

examples.title: Structured prompt
examples.prompt:
Subject: a speckled cream ceramic mug of black coffee with a thin wisp of steam, standing on a worn oak counter in the right third of the frame.
Setting: a small Scandinavian-style coffee shop at 7 a.m., empty, chairs still up on two tables in the soft-focus background, a brass espresso machine on the left.
Composition and camera: eye-level, 35mm lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, the mug is the sharpest object.
Lighting: low warm sunlight from a window on the left, long soft shadows, dust visible in the light beam.
Style: realistic editorial photography, natural colors, slight film grain.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos.

examples.title: Structured prompt + exact details and text
examples.prompt:
Subject: a speckled cream ceramic mug of black coffee with a thin wisp of steam, standing on a worn oak counter in the right third of the frame.
Setting: a small Scandinavian-style coffee shop at 7 a.m., empty, chairs still up on two tables in the soft-focus background, a brass espresso machine on the left.
Composition and camera: eye-level, 35mm lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, the mug is the sharpest object.
Lighting: low warm sunlight from a window on the left, long soft shadows, dust visible in the light beam.
Style: realistic editorial photography, natural colors, slight film grain.
Must-have details: next to the mug, a small black chalkboard sign written in white chalk handwriting that reads exactly "FLAT WHITE 3.50" on the first line and "OPEN 7:00" on the second line; a single croissant on a white plate behind the mug; a sprig of dried lavender in a tiny glass vase.
Constraints: no people, no other text, no logos.

examples.title: Edit: replace one object
examples.prompt: Edit this photo. Replace only the ceramic mug with a tall glass of iced latte with visible layers of coffee and milk and a few ice cubes. Keep everything else exactly the same: camera angle, framing, counter, espresso machine, background, light direction and shadows. The new glass must cast a matching shadow on the counter.

examples.title: Edit: change time of day, keep composition
examples.prompt: Edit this photo. Change only the time of day to a rainy evening: dark blue dusk outside the window, raindrops on the glass, warm interior pendant lamps switched on. Keep the exact same composition, objects, mug and camera angle.

examples.title: Character reference sheet
examples.prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain light grey background: the same young woman food delivery courier shown four times in a row - front view, three-quarter view, side profile, back view - full body, standing neutral pose. Fixed appearance: about 28 years old, short curly dark-brown hair, light-brown skin, small silver hoop earring in the left ear, bright yellow waterproof jacket with a reflective grey stripe across the chest, black cargo trousers, white sneakers, a square turquoise thermal delivery backpack. No brand names, no logos, no text. Clean, evenly lit studio photography.

examples.title: Same character: scene 1
examples.prompt: Use the attached character sheet as the identity reference. The same courier (same face, hair, earring, yellow jacket with grey stripe, turquoise backpack) is riding a city bicycle through a rainy evening street with wet cobblestones reflecting shop lights. Medium shot, 50mm lens, motion blur in the background. Realistic photography. No logos, no text.

examples.title: Same character: scene 2
examples.prompt: Use the attached character sheet as the identity reference. The same courier (same face, hair, earring, yellow jacket with grey stripe, turquoise backpack on her back) is standing at an apartment door and handing a brown paper food bag to a customer, whose hands only are visible. Warm hallway light, eye-level, 35mm lens. Realistic photography. No logos, no text.

examples.title: Same character: scene 3
examples.prompt: Use the attached character sheet as the identity reference. Close-up portrait of the same courier (same face, curly hair, silver hoop earring, yellow jacket with grey stripe) sitting on a park bench during a break, smiling at her phone, turquoise backpack beside her. Golden-hour backlight, 85mm lens, f/1.8. Realistic photography. No logos, no text.

examples.title: Product packshot (master reference)
examples.prompt: Studio e-commerce packshot of a single handmade ceramic mug: cylindrical body, speckled cream glaze with small brown dots, unglazed terracotta-brown band at the base, round C-shaped handle on the right. Centered, three-quarter front view, pure white seamless background, soft even light, subtle contact shadow. No text, no logo.

examples.title: Photo session: lifestyle kitchen
examples.prompt: Product photo session. Place exactly this mug (same shape, speckled cream glaze, terracotta base band, handle on the right) on a light travertine kitchen counter next to a window in the morning. A moka pot and a linen towel out of focus behind. Soft natural light, 50mm lens, f/2.8. Do not change the mug's shape, color, glaze pattern or proportions.

examples.title: Photo session: flat lay
examples.prompt: Product photo session. Overhead flat lay, top-down view: exactly this mug (same speckled cream glaze and terracotta base) filled with cappuccino with latte art, on a sage-green linen cloth, surrounded by scattered coffee beans, an open notebook and a small spoon. Even diffused light. Do not change the mug's design.

examples.title: Photo session: in use outdoors
examples.prompt: Product photo session. Two hands in a knitted beige sweater hold exactly this mug (same speckled cream glaze, terracotta base band, handle shape) at an outdoor cafe table on an autumn morning; blurred street and fallen leaves in the background. 85mm lens, f/1.8, warm tones. Keep the mug design identical.

examples.title: Photo session: ad banner with text
examples.prompt: Minimalist advertising banner. Exactly this mug on a dark charcoal stone surface, dramatic side light from the left, a soft curl of steam. Large clean sans-serif headline in the upper area that reads exactly "MORNING RITUAL" and a smaller line below it that reads exactly "Handmade ceramics". Generous negative space. Keep the mug design identical.

examples.title: Multi-reference composition: character + product
examples.prompt: Combine the two references. Image 1 is the character (identity reference), image 2 is the product (product reference). The same courier from image 1, in her yellow jacket with grey stripe, sits at a coffee shop window counter on her break and drinks from exactly the mug from image 2 (same speckled cream glaze and terracotta base). Her turquoise backpack is on the floor next to her stool. Morning light, 35mm lens, realistic photography. No logos, no text.

examples.title: Style transfer: same scene, different medium
examples.prompt: Redraw this exact scene as a flat vector illustration in a limited palette of five colors (cream, oak brown, brass yellow, sage green, charcoal), clean outlines, no gradients. Keep the composition, objects and their positions identical.
